# Versions CI installs, so a new upstream release cannot turn every PR red overnight.
#
# ci.yml passes this file to pip with -c on every install. It only caps what pip may pick; it adds
# no packages. Packages pyproject.toml already pins exactly (pytest, ruff, idna, pypdf, reportlab,
# markdown-it-py, xlrd) are left out, so pyproject stays their one source of truth.
#
# Source: the green CI run 39169340865 on 4a440b6 (merged head of PR #15) (pip 26.2.1, CPython 3.12.13, Linux), the
# "Successfully installed" list of `pip install -e ".[dev,browser,companion,evm]"`.
# Linux-only entries (jeepney, SecretStorage) are ignored where pip does not need them.
#
# To bump: change the version here (and in pyproject.toml if its floor moves), push, and let CI
# prove it. To regenerate all of it, install the extras above into a clean 3.12 venv without -c,
# run the suite, and replace the list with that venv's `pip freeze --exclude-editable`, minus the
# exact pins named above.
